caption: The drawing contains a single wooden scoop or spade-like tool depicted in the center on a light beige background. The tool has a spatula-shaped blade with a flat edge and a smoothly tapered handle terminating in a rectangular, open-ended grip. The blade portion shows natural wood grain in shades of brown and tan. In the upper right corner of the drawing, there is a small technical sketch of the same scoop, drawn in simple lines and annotated with dimensions: 18 inches in total length and 12 inches for the width of the blade. The ratio 1/8 : 1" is also noted near the technical sketch. The rest of the background is plain and unadorned.
title: Grain Scoop
